zOrderNote: Deviation from the brief: screen and antennas sit BELOW tv-body (body bezel overlaps their edges, exact recomposite, rotation-safe). Swap only if you also use the hard-edged window variant.

layers.name: ribbon-rear
layers.note: Bronze inner face of the ribbon, behind the right bezel (extends 16px under the bezel, hidden by tv-body).

layers.name: screen
layers.note: Clean glass plate (no play button, no ribbon); extends ~4px under the bezel. Drawn BELOW tv-body so the bezel lip covers its edge.

layers.name: antenna-left
layers.note: Left antenna rod+ball; rod extends ~16px below the bezel top edge so it can rotate; drawn BELOW tv-body (body hides the extension).

layers.name: antenna-right
layers.note: Right antenna rod+ball; same as left.

layers.name: tv-body
layers.note: Silver frame with transparent screen window, feet. No antennas, no ribbon, no play button.

layers.name: play-button
layers.note: Cream triangle with its soft dark shadow (black, partial alpha).

layers.name: ribbon-front
layers.note: Ribbon front sweep from the right wrap to the free tail, plus its specular glow and edge shadow as partial-alpha pixels.

layers.name: sweep-mask
layers.note: Alpha of all silver parts (body + antennas), white RGB.

layers.name: glint-mask
layers.note: Soft highlight spots (antenna ball tips, top bezel edge), white RGB.

ribbon.order: rear top-right end -> behind frame -> split -> front right wrap -> along band -> free tail end

weakSpots: Clean-plate glass behind play button and ribbon is synthesized (smooth gradient + grain).
Lower-left frame corner/bar under the ribbon is synthesized (mirror/cross-fade of visible bezel).
Rear ribbon extension under the bezel is inpainted (hidden).
